name: privoperps
description: PRIVO SDK and core on Robinhood Chain: spot swaps through Uniswap with the PRIVO fee, limit orders and TWAP, Orderly perps, sealed OTC block trades, and the Block desk and Orders contracts. An MCP server (privo-mcp) for AI agents. Every trade is signed by your own wallet.
